text:
Ethan: heads-up — i'm proposing we change deploybot's pin behavior for runtime/4.1 mismatches to introduce a 'pin decay' TTL and zonal-fallback ordering. current flow hard-pins immediately which creates big perf cliffs for huge-doc workloads. want to trial a phased soft-route + pin-decay approach in off-peak window (03:00-05:00 UTC). cc @Maya @Harper

deploybot: Observed mismatch: sdk=3.9 vs runtime=4.1. Default: hard-pin queued (id=pin-4312349999).

Maya: explain pin decay? curious about edge cases where we accidentally let incompatible traffic run long.

Ethan: pin decay = when a hard pin is created, it carries a TTL (e.g., 48h) after which deploybot will automatically re-evaluate the need to keep the pin based on recent compat events. This prevents permanent stickiness from transient regressions. For the experiment: no immediate hard pin; instead: 1) header X-Compat:soft for 1% traffic, 2) route by zonal preference (prefer same-region variant), 3) if compat_metric >= 0.87 continue, else escalate to regional_variant, 4) only hard-pin if sustained breach for 20m OR token_shape_mismatch > 0.7% for 10m.

Harper: need a deadman and an escape hatch. also insist on a runbook with exact thresholds and the rollback command.

Ethan: agreed. rollback command: `deployctl pin --runtime=3.9 --reason="pin-decay-fail" --retain-ttl=72h` (ops). runbook conditions to force immediate pin: error_rate > 1.8% sustained 12m OR p95 > 2.5x baseline 10m OR token_shape_mismatch > 0.7% 10m.

Maya: can we add a canary guard called `canary_bomb_protection` so if the canary itself causes an amplification spike we auto-throttle traffic?

deploybot: Feature note: `canary_bomb_protection` toggled by flag. When enabled, canary percentage cannot ramp > x2 every 30m and emergency throttle is available.

Harper: operational asks: 1) emit structured events `pin.decay.event` with canary id and zonal decisions, 2) add pin_ttl metadata to the pin object, 3) expose a console action to override pin TTL manually.

sre-bot: Created alert: infra/compat/pin-decay-4312349999 -> pager if error_rate > 1.5% for 5m. Also created dashboard: https://console.redwood/d/ops/pin-decay-experiment (id: pdx-4312).

Maya: SDK change: i'll add `compat_metric` and `token_shape_estimate` to the initial handshake and a flag `x-kv-simulate` for a simulated KV-compat probe. PR will reference the experiment.

Ethan: config snippet for deploybot experiment (to be added to canary body):

```
pin_decay: true
canary_percent: 1
compat_threshold: 0.87
zonal_preference: ["same-region","regional-variant"]
hard_pin_guard_minutes: 20
pin_ttl_hours: 48
canary_bomb_protection: true
```

Harper: please ensure deploybot logs include `canary_id` and `zonal_route` fields so we can trace cross-zone behavior. Also add a 'pin-origin' tag to pins created during the experiment.

deploybot: Canary scheduled -> pin-decay-4312349999 in eu-west (1%) at 03:10 UTC. Logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/pin-decay-4312349999

sre-bot: i'll watch p95 and token_shape_mismatch. if we see early signs of KV thrash i'll toggle KVCACHE_EVICT_RATIO down for canary nodes to reduce eviction churn.

Maya: added PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1582 - exposes compat_metric + token_shape_estimate and a feature-flagged KV probe. Also opened release-notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/1001 with the experiment checklist and rollback commands.

Harper: i'll wire the pager: ops/compat-pin -> oncall if error_rate > 1.2% for 6m. i'll also prepare a short support blurb in case customers file degradation tickets.

Ethan: if canary passes 90m we will lift the immediate-pin behavior for runtime/4.1 in eu-west and schedule a controlled roll (10% over 6h) with pin_ttl defaulted to 72h. i'll post a summary and final decision in this thread.

Maya: :thumbsup: good to have pin TTL; reduces follow-on toil.

Harper: :eyes: monitoring now. deploybot — include both canary_id and event link in the exit signal when you post the final status.

deploybot: Canary started -> pin-decay-4312349999 at 03:10 UTC. Monitoring topic: events.release.pin-decay. Good luck. :rocket:
